curation.name: Polite Bow
curation.summary: Small gentle bow with head and body lowering, returning to standing; generated with Microduck Motion Lab from the official sim-to-real stack.
curation.details: No machine-readable policy manifest is published with this artifact, so runtime facts remain unknown. The publisher task is Mjlab-PoliteBow-Flat-MicroDuck (standup recipe, 4096 envs, 1000 PPO iterations); its deployment checks report passed export, 61D/14D contract and CPU rehearsal with the motion-quality gate passed. Upstream metadata declares no license, so reuse needs maintainer review.
curation.notes: No manifest is published and upstream metadata declares no license; the ONNX interface is inspected only. The publisher warns a simulation preview is not a guarantee of safe real-robot behavior. The registry records no independent hardware evidence.

publisher_hardware.note: The publisher reports a headless CPU MuJoCo deployment rehearsal only and no physical MicroDuck deployment evidence.
